status.en: 16 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Mogadishu, Puntland and Baidoa.
status.nb: 16 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Mogadishu, Puntland og Baidoa.

summary.en: Federal forces have relaunched the previously failed Banooda operation, moving a major troop convoy while the defence minister reported killing nearly 285 al-Shabaab fighters, including 12 leaders, in Bay, Shabelle and Hiiraan. The United States conducted airstrikes on three al-Shabaab sites in Somalia. President Museveni of Uganda met Somalia's president to discuss regional security and the AU peacekeeping transition, and the Ugandan army chief visited Somali troops amid a withdrawal from Barawe. Somalia warned that unrest in Ethiopia could weaken security operations involving the African Union mission. The conflict produced 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Føderale styrker har gjenopptatt den tidligere mislykkede Banooda-operasjonen, og flytter en stor troppekonvoi mens forsvarsministeren rapporterte at nesten 285 al-shabaab-krigere, inkludert 12 ledere, ble drept i Bay, Shabelle og Hiiraan. USA gjennomførte luftangrep på tre al-shabaab-steder i Somalia. President Museveni fra Uganda møtte Somalias president for å diskutere regional sikkerhet og overgangen av AU-fredsbevaringen, og den ugandiske hærens sjef besøkte somaliske tropper under et tilbaketrekning fra Barawe. Somalia advarte om at uro i Etiopia kan svekke sikkerhetsoperasjoner som involverer Den afrikanske unions oppdrag. Konflikten førte til 2 284 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.extract: The ongoing phase of the Somali Civil War began in 2009 and is concentrated in southern and central Somalia, primarily between the forces of the Federal Government of Somalia (FGS), assisted by African Union peacekeeping forces, and the Islamist militant group al-Shabaab, which pledged allegiance to al-Qaeda in 2012.
